overview: A simulated consumer-ownership and business DAO platform with a Founding Credits rewards program, QR-powered simulated checkout, and a public roadmap.
features: Earn Founding Credits for verified participation with a configurable reward table
Founding Member and Founding Business badges with a unique founding member number
Founding Credits dashboard with balance, lifetime earned and contribution history
Personal referral link with a downloadable QR code
Simulated QR checkout with catalogue, cart, dynamic transaction QR and digital receipt
Business reconciliation view with revenue, contributions and platform fees shown separately
Credit distribution and referral metrics in founder analytics
